title: Auto-improvement suggestions index
description: company-profile/<company_id>/suggestions/master.json: every code or configuration change Maxwell proposed for the company, with its review and merge lifecycle. The suggestion_acceptance_rate KPI computes accepted/surfaced from status and surfacedAt, merge rate from mergedAt and repos[].mergeCommit, revert rate from revertedAt and repos[].revertCommit, and 30-day retention from retentionCheckedAt and retained; superseded and expired entries are bucketed by closedAt and a supersession chain counts once. Diffs live at suggestions/suggestions/<sug_id>/<repo_id>/<name>.diff

suggestions.title: Add CycloneDX SBOM generation job to build.yml
suggestions.rationale: SEBI CSCRF GV.SC.S5 expects regulated entities to maintain a software bill of materials for critical applications. The trading-gateway-api GitHub Actions workflow builds and pushes an image but never records its dependency inventory. This diff adds an sbom job that runs cyclonedx-gomod on the module, uploads sbom.cdx.json as a 400-day artefact and fails the workflow if generation fails, so every production image has a matching SBOM
suggestions.decisionNote: Accepted; pinned the cyclonedx-gomod action to a commit SHA during review

companyId.description: Slug of the company this index belongs to; must equal the company-profile directory name

updatedAt.description: When this index was last rewritten; the KPI treats it as the observation time for open suggestions

suggestions.description: Every suggestion ever raised, including rejected, reverted, superseded and expired ones; never delete entries. suggestionId must be unique across the array

category.description: Kind of improvement the diff makes; one value per suggestion, split multi-purpose changes into several suggestions

repoChange.description: The diff proposed for one repository. One suggestion may span several repos of the same application

diffPath.description: Workspace-root-relative path of the unified diff: company-profile/<company_id>/suggestions/suggestions/<sug_id>/<repo_id>/<name>.diff, where <sug_id> equals suggestionId and <repo_id> equals repoId

baseCommit.description: Commit of the repo's default branch the diff applies cleanly to

mergeCommit.description: Merge (or squash) commit that landed the diff on the default branch; present exactly when status is merged or reverted. The retention check tests whether mergeCommit is an ancestor of the default branch head at retentionCheckedAt

revertCommit.description: Commit on the default branch that reverted mergeCommit; present exactly when status is reverted

revertPrUrl.description: Pull or merge request that carried the revert, when it went through one; only for status reverted

linesAdded.description: Count of + lines in the diff, excluding headers

linesRemoved.description: Count of - lines in the diff, excluding headers

filesChanged.description: Number of distinct files the diff touches

suggestion.description: One proposed change and its lifecycle: proposed -> surfaced -> accepted|rejected; accepted -> merged -> (reverted); any open state -> superseded|expired. Timestamps must be present exactly as the status implies: surfacedAt from surfaced onward, decidedAt and decidedBy from accepted/rejected/merged/reverted, mergedAt and repos[].mergeCommit for merged and reverted, revertedAt and repos[].revertCommit for reverted only, closedAt and (for superseded) supersededBy for superseded and expired only

suggestionId.description: Prefixed ULID; also the directory name under suggestions/suggestions/

title.description: Imperative one-line summary suitable as a PR title

rationale.description: Why the change is needed, what the diff does and what risk it addresses; becomes the PR body

severity.description: Severity of the gap the suggestion closes, inherited from the linked finding

surfacedAt.description: When the suggestion was shown to a human (PR opened, ticket raised or report section written); denominator of suggestion_acceptance_rate

decidedAt.description: When a human accepted or rejected it; required from accepted, rejected, merged and reverted

decidedBy.description: Human (or delegated script) that made the accept/reject decision; never an agent, so a suggestion cannot accept itself

decisionNote.description: Reviewer's reason, especially for rejections; feeds prompt tuning

mergedAt.description: When the change landed on the default branch (repos[].mergeCommit); present only for merged and reverted

revertedAt.description: When the merged change was reverted (repos[].revertCommit); present only for reverted. Counted by revert rate

closedAt.description: When the suggestion was superseded or expired without a decision; present only for those two statuses. Buckets them into the acceptance-rate denominator period

supersededBy.description: The newer suggestion that replaced this one; present exactly when status is superseded. The KPI counts a supersession chain once, at its final entry

retentionCheckedAt.description: When the 30-day retention check ran (mergedAt + 30 days or later); set together with retained

retained.description: true when every repos[].mergeCommit was still an ancestor of the default branch head at retentionCheckedAt; feeds 30-day retention

prUrls.description: Pull or merge requests opened for the suggestion; empty until surfaced as a PR

repos.description: One entry per repository the suggestion changes

controlIds.description: Ids of control records in the company's soc ledger that the change implements or strengthens (same meaning as controlIds on soc records); each must exist in the ledger and should correspond to a regulatoryRefs entry

regulatoryRefs.description: Regulatory clauses the change helps satisfy; at least one unless category is other

initiativeId.description: Change-management initiative the suggestion implements, when raised from one

sourceWorkflow.description: Workflow that generated the diff (usually impl-auto-improvement)

provenance.description: Provenance of this suggestion entry, distinct from the index-level provenance. provenance.model must be set: it is a dimension of suggestion_acceptance_rate
